descriptions.text: Upgrade Patch. Small. This patch depicts the planet Earth, which is currently under the regency of the Borant System. Ahh, the planet earth. A whole lot of culture. A whole lot of spunk. So many dumbasses. If this upgrade patch is affixed to an eligible garment, it will imbue the following upgrades: +5% to Strength. Immunity from cloud-based attacks. Warning: Upgrade patches are fleeting items. You may remove them, but they will be destroyed in the process.

recap.text: Carl's platinum Spicy Box gives up a black sleeveless jacket, a small unenchanted sewing kit with white and red thread, and a round patch of planet Earth the size of a half-dollar, made to be sewn on. Donut hops onto the table, shoves the patch aside in disgust, and calls it a screen print, amateur hour. Mordecai says Carl has some immunities already, but the patch adds another layer of protection, so he should sew it on right away.

Carl watches the class specialties on his screen and cannot click anything. Revolutionary puts him first in line, takes a tear gas canister to the chest, and swings first. It grants immunity to cloud-based attacks, which the menu marks as already obtained by upgrade patch. Katia sews the gold box's flaming-arrow patch beside the planet earth on his jacket.

beats.headline: A screen-printed planet Earth
beats.text: Three things pop out of the platinum Spicy Box: a black sleeveless jacket, a tiny round patch depicting the planet earth, and a small unenchanted sewing kit with white and red thread. The patch is the size of a half-dollar, not attached to the jacket but clearly meant to be sewn on. Donut jumps to the table to inspect it and pushes it aside with a strange amount of disgust. This is just a screen print. Amateur hour. Carl has several immunities already, says Mordecai, but this is another layer of protection: sew it on right away, and mind the space.
beats.gist: Mordecai tells Carl to sew on a tiny Earth patch right away; Donut sniffs at it.

beats.headline: Immune by patch already
beats.text: On the sixth floor the specialties for Carl's class play out on his screen, and he cannot click anything; he just has to watch. Revolutionary means the front of the line, a tear gas canister to the chest, the first to start swinging. It gives an extra point of strength at every level, two to Unarmed Combat, faster melee training, the Blend into the Crowd benefit, and immunity to cloud-based attacks, which the menu marks as already obtained via upgrade patch.
beats.gist: Carl's class specialties play out on his screen, and cloud-attack immunity is already marked obtained.

beats.headline: Arrows on the shoulder
beats.text: The gold ranged weapon box holds a small square patch, about the size of Carl's first, the planet earth: a dozen flaming arrows clutched in an eagle claw, drawn Sailor Jerry style. Each new patch adds a point to all his stats plus its own benefit. Katia, who affixed the first one, has already grabbed the sewing kit. She takes the jacket, maps out the best places, and sews the arrow patch next to the planet earth on the shoulder.
beats.gist: Katia sews the new arrow patch beside the planet earth patch on Carl's jacket shoulder.
